verses.1: David, do not take revenge against the evil people; do not hate those who do evil.
verses.2: For a field of wildflowers will soon be overgrown, and the weeds will spread everywhere.
verses.3: Trust in the LORD, and do good deeds on this earth. And do not do evil.
verses.4: And he will rejoice in Jehovah, and he will give you answers to your questions.
verses.5: May God guide you along His path, and He will surely do so.
verses.6: And let your righteousness and your justice shine forth as the sun.
verses.7: Let him not be disturbed by anyone who tries to hinder his path.
verses.8: Let him leave and abandon his love; do not let it bother him anymore.
verses.9: For the evil ones will be punished, and the people of Jehovah will inherit the land.
verses.10: And yet, there’s still no evil person among them. They’re not evil at all.
verses.11: And those who are hungry will inherit the land, and they will enjoy great prosperity.
verses.12: The wicked will be defeated by the righteous, and their evil deeds will be exposed.
verses.13: Adonai will play for him, as he sees that his time has come.
verses.14: The wicked opened their mouths to deceive the poor and needy, and they tried to harm those who were righteous.
verses.15: Their darkness will be dispelled from their hearts, and their sorrows will be relieved.
verses.16: It’s good for the righteous to be separated from many wicked people.
verses.17: For the wicked’s branches will be cut off, but the righteous’s names will be blessed by Jehovah.
verses.18: May Jehovah know the days of their innocence, and their land shall remain prosperous forever.
verses.19: They will not be destroyed in times of trouble, and in days of famine they will be preserved.
verses.20: For the wicked will be destroyed, and those who are enemies of Jehovah will be punished just as figs are destroyed by fire. They will be completely destroyed.
verses.21: The wicked will not be rewarded, while the righteous will be honored and rewarded.
verses.22: For those who are blessed, they will inherit land; and those who are cursed, they will be destroyed.
verses.23: By the will of Jehovah, these plans were made and their paths were determined.
verses.24: For he will not be saved, because the LORD has turned away from him.
verses.25: I was also a young man, yet I was already old. I didn’t see any righteous person who would abandon his descendants and beg for food.
verses.26: Every day, it grows and produces seeds that bring blessings.
verses.27: Avoid evil and do good; may you live forever.
verses.28: For the LORD loves justice, and He will not abandon His faithful ones forever. They will be protected, but the seeds of the wicked will be destroyed.
verses.29: The righteous will inherit the land and live there forever.
verses.30: The righteous will possess wisdom, and they will speak from the judgment of God.
verses.31: Do not forget the teachings of your God in your heart.
verses.32: The wicked try to harm the righteous and want to kill them.
verses.33: YHWH will not leave us in His hands, nor will He save us through His judgment.
verses.34: Hear the voice of the LORD, and keep His ways. Then you will be able to possess the land, while the wicked are punished.
verses.35: I saw a wicked man who was arrogant and self-serving, like a poisonous plant.
verses.36: And he went away, but I couldn’t find him. I tried to search for him, but I couldn’t find him at all.
verses.37: Keep yourself safe, and see that you do what is right, after all those who are happy.
verses.38: And the wicked were punished together. The evil ones were destroyed in one fell manner.
verses.39: And the salvation of the righteous comes from Jehovah in times of distress.
verses.40: And Jehovah will help them, and He will deliver them from the wicked. For He has mercy on them.
